<b>3. Steruj pomieszczeniem.</b> Siedząc: 3. Control the room. While in a hijacked APC, you click machines in its room like an AI: doors (Shift/Ctrl/Alt+click), consoles, cameras, holopad, radio, bots, cyborgs in a charging station. Clicking the hijacked APC always takes you back.
<b>4. Kupuj zdolności.</b> Każde przejęt: 4. Buy abilities. Each hijacked APC is a point to spend in the Ability Menu (the button with a charger). Purchased abilities appear on the bar. There you can also upgrade your body, set the drain rate and disable the cable view.
<b>5. Uważaj na EMP i jony</b>: tylko on: 5. Beware of EMPs and ions: only they can seriously hurt you. You can speak only through a radio, holopad or a hijacked cyborg, and the "Demonic Whisper" reaches the mind of anyone within sight.

<b>Lista typów holoparazytów</b><br><br>:
Holoparasite Type List

Assassin: deals medium damage and takes full damage, but can go into stealth, making its next attack deal massive damage and ignore armor. After a stealth attack it cannot return to its user for a short time.

Chaos: sets enemies on fire with its touch and makes them see everyone around them as a parasite. Automatically extinguishes its user if they start burning.

Charger: moves incredibly fast, deals medium damage and can charge at targets, hurting the first one it hits and forcing them to drop held items.

Explosive: high damage resistance and a medium-strength attack that can explosively teleport targets. Can turn any object, even one too large to pick up, into a bomb that hurts the next person to touch it. The object returns to normal after the trap goes off or after some time.

Lightning: attacks place chains of lightning on targets. Has a chain of lightning linked to its user. The chains shock everything nearby, dealing continuous damage.

Protector: unlike other parasites, you teleport to it when you are out of range. Has two modes: combat, in which it deals and takes medium damage, and protection, in which it deals and takes almost no damage but moves a bit slower.

Ranged: has two modes. Ranged - fires a continuous stream of weak projectiles that ignore armor. Scouting - cannot attack, but passes through walls and is hard to notice. In both modes it can set surveillance snares that warn it when someone passes through them.

Standard: devastating melee attacks and high damage resistance. Can break through weak walls.

Gravitokinetic: attacks apply crushing gravity to the target. Can also target the ground to slow incoming enemies, but this affects the user as well.

Welcome to the Nanotrasen Gateway project...
Congratulations! If you're reading this, you and your superiors have decided that you're ready to commit to a life spent colonising the rolling hills of far away worlds. You must be ready for a lifetime of adventure, a little bit of hard work, and an award winning dental plan - but that's not all the Nanotrasen Gateway project has to offer.

Because we care about you, we feel it is only fair to make sure you know the risks before you commit to joining the Nanotrasen Gateway project. All away destinations have been fully scanned by a Nanotrasen expeditionary team, and are certified to be 100% safe. We've even left a case of space beer along with the basic materials you'll need to expand Nanotrasen's operational area and start your new life.

Gateway Operation Basics
All Nanotrasen approved Gateways operate on the same basic principals. They operate off area equipment power as you would expect, and without this supply, it cannot safely function, causing it to reject all attempts at operation.

Once it is correctly setup, and once it has enough power to operate, the Gateway will begin searching for an output location. The amount of time this takes is variable, but the Gateway interface will give you an estimate accurate to the minute. Power loss will not interrupt the searching process. Influenza will not interrupt the searching process. Temporal anomalies may cause the estimate to be inaccurate, but will not interrupt the searching process.

Life On The Other Side
Once you have traversed the Gateway, you may experience some disorientation. Do not panic. This is a normal side effect of travelling vast distances in a short period of time. You should survey the immediate area, and attempt to locate your complimentary case of space beer. Our expeditionary teams have ensured the complete safety of all away locations, but in a small number of cases, the Gateway they have established may not be immediately obvious. Do not panic if you cannot locate the return Gateway. Begin colonisation of the destination.

A New World
As a participant in the Nanotrasen Gateway Project, you will be on the frontiers of space. Though complete safety is assured, participants are advised to prepare for inhospitable environs.

NANOTRASEN - CREW RECOVERY DEPARTMENT
Body Intake Card
The bag contains the remains of a crew member recovered from a wreck. The body has been preserved with formaldehyde, so it undergoes no further decomposition.

Procedure:
1. Take the bag to medbay and lay the body on an operating table.
2. Examine it with a health analyzer: check organs, missing limbs, blood level and wounds.
3. Repair or replace damaged organs (heart, lungs, liver), sew on a missing limb or fit a prosthetic, replenish blood.
4. Remove the formaldehyde from the blood (activated charcoal or blood filtration), because after revival it poisons the patient.
5. Heal injuries enough for the patient to survive and use a defibrillator.

After a successful resuscitation the body will be taken over by a volunteer: the patient doesn't remember who they were, they only know their name and job. If nobody volunteers, the body will die again.

Bonus: if the patient survives three minutes after resuscitation, the medical department will receive 3000 credits.

Greetings, agent, and congratulations on your new position as a contractor. In addition to the objectives already assigned to you, this kit will provide you with contracts to complete for TC payouts.

Inside you will find a specialist contractor space suit. It is even more compact - it fits in a pocket - and faster than the Syndicate space suit available in the uplink. We have also included a chameleon jumpsuit and mask, which can be changed at any time into any form you need. The cigarettes are a special blend - over time they slowly heal your wounds.

Your standard contractor baton hits harder than those you may be used to, and will probably be your main weapon for abducting targets. Three additional items have been randomly selected from what we had in stock. We hope they prove useful on your mission.

The Contractor Hub, accessible in the top right corner of the uplink, will provide you with unique items and abilities. They are bought with Contractor Rep - for every contract you complete you receive two points.

Using the tablet

  1. Open the Syndicate Contract Uplink program.
  2. Here you can accept a contract and collect TC payouts for completed contracts.
  3. The amount in parentheses is the bonus you receive for delivering the target alive. You receive the other amount regardless of whether the target is alive.
  4. You complete a contract by delivering the target to the designated drop-off point, calling extraction and placing them in the pod.

Be careful when accepting a contract. You will see the location of the drop-off point, but cancelling will make it impossible to accept it again.

The tablet can also be charged in any cell charger.

Extraction

  1. Make sure you and your target are at the drop-off point.
  2. Call extraction and step away from the drop-off point.
  3. If it fails, make sure the target is inside and that there is a free spot for the pod to land.
  4. Grab the target and pull them into the pod.

Ransoms

We need your target for our own purposes, but once they are no longer useful we send them back, for a ransom, to the area of your mission. They will return after a few minutes at the place you sent them from. Don't worry, you will get a cut of what they pay us. We will deposit it on the ID card you are carrying, in addition to your TC payout.

Good luck, agent. You may burn this document with the included lighter.

Działo podmuchowe to wysoce wyspecjalizo: The blast cannon is a highly specialized weapon, though actually quite simple. It has a mount for a tank's relief valve, set on a curved pipe specially built to withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and a mechanical trigger that operates the valve. In practice it turns the force of a bomb's explosion into a narrow shockwave - a “projectile”. Ambitious scientists may find it extremely useful, because focusing the pressure wave into a narrow angle apparently bypasses the quirk of physics that keeps explosions from exceeding a certain range. This way the device uses the theoretical power of a bomb with a relief valve instead of the actual one.

The energy detected from the rod is exactly the same as the energy coming off the tree. It all starts to make sense. Wirus nadprodukuje komórki macierzyste u: The virus overproduces stem cells geared toward forming organs. The finished organs are pushed out of the body, and the host is injured in the process.
Wirus osłabia budowę ciała. Każda część: The virus weakens the body's structure. Every body part withstands less and less damage.
Wirus osłabia skórę nosiciela. Pęka ona: The virus weakens the host's skin. It tears at every collision and touch.
Wirus pobiera plazmę z otoczenia, z butl: The virus draws plasma from the environment, from canisters and from the host's blood to heal damage and equalize body temperature.
Wirus pobudza organizm do wytwarzania an: The virus stimulates the body to produce antitoxin, which cleanses the blood and liver.
Wirus pobudza ośrodek przyjemności. Nosi: The virus stimulates the pleasure center. The host feels wonderful.
Wirus pobudza wzrost komórek i leczy obr: The virus stimulates cell growth and heals physical damage and burns, but the repair leaves toxins in the body.
Wirus pobudza ślinianki. Nosiciel się śl: The virus stimulates the salivary glands. The host drools.
Wirus podrażnia kanaliki łzowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the tear ducts. The host's eyes water.
Wirus podrażnia nerwy ruchowe. Nosiciel: The virus irritates the motor nerves. The host twitches involuntarily.
Wirus poświęca długoterminową przeżywaln: The virus sacrifices long-term survivability to spread fully through the host almost instantly. It starts at the last stage, but eventually fades away and dies off on its own.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w jas: The virus remodels the host's body into a lizard. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus przebudowuje ciało nosiciela w ćmę: The virus remodels the host's body into a moth. After being cured, the host returns to their original species.
Wirus rozkręca w ciele nosiciela nieustę: The virus winds up a relentless rhythm in the host's body. At first only strange feelings and shortness of breath, then fever and fire, and in the end the body can't take the rhythm and explodes.
Wirus rozregulowuje ośrodek strachu. Nos: The virus dysregulates the fear center. The host has panic attacks, and in the last stage coughs up butterflies.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele nosiciela „cie: The virus synthesizes a \"thin mint\" in the host's body: a substance that messes with the head.
Wirus syntetyzuje w ciele olej i inne ma: The virus synthesizes oil and other inorganic materials in the body, which the host expels. Rarely a whole robot jumps out of the mouth.
Wirus szybko przystosowuje się do jak na: The virus quickly adapts to spread as fast as possible, both outside and inside the host. As a result, however, it is easier to detect and defends itself worse against a cure. This symptom encourages mutation of the disease
Wirus uszkadza naczynia w nosie. Nosicie: The virus damages the vessels in the nose. The host gets nosebleeds, and the blood may carry the virus.
Wirus wyczula nosiciela na bóle i zakwas: The virus sensitizes the host to aches and soreness, making them tire faster.
Wirus wykorzystuje wodę w ciele i na nim: The virus uses water in and on the body to repair damaged cells. Heals burns best, and holy water works stronger.
Wirus wywołuje zapalenie błędnika. Nosic: The virus causes labyrinthitis. The host feels dizzy.
Wirus zagnieżdża się w ośrodkach społecz: The virus nests in the brain's social centers: it rewards the host for being in a crowd of potential victims and punishes them for being alone.
Wirus łączy się symbiotycznie z komórkam: The virus bonds symbiotically with the cells of the host's body, preventing aging and reversing it. In return, the virus becomes more resistant, spreads faster and is harder to detect, although it develops worse without a host.

text: 'Dobrze znosisz chłód i niskie ciś: text: 'You tolerate cold and low pressure well, but extreme cold and vacuum hurt you. This does not affect you inside a host, and a spacesuit will protect the host.',
text: 'Dorosły robak może się rozmnożyć:: text: 'An adult worm can reproduce: 3 new larvae come out of the cocoon, and you yourself return to larva form.',
text: 'Gdy zostanie ci mniej niż 10% zdr: text: 'If less than 10% of your health remains in the blood, the host will eject you. It is a chance to escape at the last moment.',
text: 'Każda udzielona lekcja dodaje nam: text: 'Every lesson given adds to our strength. With right click we can turn walls into glass to reach even further.',
text: 'Korporacja DeForest stworzyła jed: text: 'The DeForest Corporation has created single-use testers that detect blood worms. Security can order them from cargo. They work instantly, but they hurt and are expensive.',
text: 'Larwy chodzą rurami wentylacji. P: text: 'Larvae travel through ventilation pipes. After maturing you lose this ability and are left with slipping under doors, breaking doors down and ID access. Before you mature, find a good spot or a host.',
text: 'Leczenie nosiciela w medbayu zami: text: 'Healing a host in medbay instead of with your own blood does not leave them deathly pale and saves blood for spitting and healing.',
text: 'Lodówki z krwią w medbayu to niez: text: 'Blood fridges in medbay are a decent source of synthetic blood when there are no monkeys. Be careful, breaking a fridge can be heard through walls.',
text: 'Mały zasięg ataku i znikome obraż: text: 'Short attack range and negligible damage, but great for quick escapes and repositioning.',
text: 'Możesz wyjść z nosiciela, by kogo: text: 'You can leave a host to surprise someone, especially as an adult. Cut off escape routes first, because exiting takes 3 seconds.',
text: 'Nie musisz oddychać. Dotyczy to t: text: 'You do not need to breathe. This applies to your hosts as well.',
text: 'Nosiciel nie potrzebuje oddychać: text: 'A host does not need to breathe or have a working heart and liver, a brain is enough. You can revive a dead host with its own blood.',
text: 'Nosicielom brakuje twoich zmysłów: text: 'Hosts lack your senses, so darkness and flashbangs affect them normally. Night vision goggles, eye protection and ear protection will help.',
text: 'Ochrona cię złapała? Z aktywnym P: text: 'Caught by security? With Blood Spit active, right click dissolves handcuffs, straitjackets and even locker hinges. You can also leave the host and escape through the vents or through the door.',
text: 'Postęp wzrostu widać na przycisku: text: 'Growth progress is visible on the maturation button and when hovering over the worm icon in the top right corner. Once you have grown, seal yourself in a cocoon to advance to the next stage. A young worm spits blood, and an adult is extremely strong.',
text: 'Potrafisz zamienić się w krew i w: text: 'You can turn into blood and enter a human corpse, making it your host. You can also drag yourself onto a corpse.',
text: 'Powoli się leczysz, z progu śmier: text: 'You heal slowly, from the brink of death to full health in about 5 minutes. In a host this means slowly regaining blood. By injecting blood you quickly heal the host at the cost of your own health.',
text: 'Rośniesz, pijąc krew Wysysaniem k: text: 'You grow by drinking blood with Blood Drain or by entering corpses. Synthetic blood, e.g. from monkeys and blood bags, counts towards growth only up to a certain limit. The HUD shows the blood level of everyone, and examining a target tells you how much blood they have and how much they would give you.',
text: 'Twój umysł nie jest ludzki. Nie z: text: 'Your mind is not human. You know no fear, even in a host.',
text: 'W kosmosie jesteś niewidzialny i: text: 'In space you are invisible and your wounds heal. You pass freely through glass, but an electrified grille will stop you.',
text: 'W nosicielu cały jesteś krwią, wi: text: 'Inside a host you are entirely blood, so their bleeding hurts you directly. Hosts also bleed after death and 50% faster than normal humans.',
text: 'Wnikając w zwłoki, błyskawicznie: text: 'By entering a corpse, you instantly drink all of its blood. Blood obtained while already in a host does not count towards growth.',
text: 'Wpatruj się w ofiarę, która cię w: text: 'Stare at a victim who sees you to stun and weaken them. This is how you give away your presence.',
text: 'Wysysasz powietrze prosto z płuc: text: 'You suck the air straight out of their lungs and quickly take down even the strongest. If they resist, right click deals normal damage. Your hands are only good for carrying things.',
text: 'Źle znosisz wysoką temperaturę i: text: 'You tolerate high temperatures poorly and burn up quickly in them. This also applies inside a host, unless you dress them in a fireproof outfit.',
